description: This file defines data structures and functions related to Marketplace plugins in Mattermost, including plugin metadata, filtering, decoding signatures, and reading plugin lists from JSON.

classes.name: BaseMarketplacePlugin
classes.description: Represents a plugin received from the Marketplace server with metadata such as URLs, labels, hosting info, and signature.

classes.name: MarketplaceLabel
classes.description: Represents a label shown in the Marketplace UI.

classes.name: MarketplacePlugin
classes.description: A state-aware Marketplace plugin extending BaseMarketplacePlugin with an installed version.

classes.name: MarketplacePluginFilter
classes.description: Parameters to filter plugin requests, including pagination, platform, and enterprise options.

classes.name: InstallMarketplacePluginRequest
classes.description: Parameters for requesting installation of a specific plugin version.

methods.name: BaseMarketplacePluginsFromReader
methods.description: Decodes a JSON list of BaseMarketplacePlugin objects from an io.Reader.

methods.name: MarketplacePluginsFromReader
methods.description: Decodes a JSON list of MarketplacePlugin objects from an io.Reader.

methods.name: DecodeSignature
methods.description: Decodes the plugin's signature from base64 and returns an io.ReadSeeker.

methods.name: ApplyToURL
methods.description: Adds filter parameters to a URL as query string.

methods.name: ToValues
methods.description: Converts filter parameters to url.Values for query string encoding.

methods.name: PluginRequestFromReader
methods.description: Decodes a JSON-encoded plugin request from an io.Reader.
